title: What's wrong with my Sage coffee machine?
desc: Damping Off: This condition is caused by a fungus that thrives in overly moist soils. It often results in your sage wilting and dying unexpectedly. Factors contributing to this issue may include excessively moist soil or high nitrogen levels in the soil. Sage is adaptable and can grow well in various conditions, but it does not require excessive watering or fertiliser.

title: What are the most common repairs for an espresso machine?
desc: The most common problems with Sage espresso machines include issues with coffee extraction, water pressure, heating, steam wand functionality, power supply, and malfunctions of the control panel. Let's discuss these in greater detail and how to resolve them.

title: Does sage need to be washed?
desc: Reap fresh sage, ensuring that you do not detach the leaves from the stems. Rinse the leaves thoroughly and dry them with a clean towel, trying to remove as much moisture as possible. Then, bundle the stems together using a rubber band and hang them upside down in a well-ventilated area.

title: How many times should I run water through after descaling?
desc: Run the coffee maker through two complete brewing cycles to flush the unit after descaling. Use a full carafe of fresh, cold water each time.

title: Does coffee taste better after descaling?
desc: Descaling is an essential part of maintaining your Sage coffee maker. If you neglect to descale regularly, you may experience problems such as poor flavor and inefficient heating. By descaling your coffee maker, you remove the mineral deposits that build up over time, ensuring that it operates at its best and produces great-tasting coffee.

title: Can I continue using my coffee machine if it requires descaling?
desc: Mineral scale buildup can obstruct water flow, and if left unaddressed, it may cause a machine to stop functioning properly. As a result, your Sage coffee might not be hot enough to enjoy.

title: How do you clean an L or coffee pod machine?
desc:
Cleaning L'OR Barista Coffee Machine
  • Remove the drip tray, wastewater drawer and capsule drawer.
  • Take out the drip tray.
  • Rinse the drip tray and drip tray cover with warm water or clean it using the dishwasher.
  • Take out the capsule drawer.
  • Empty the capsule drawer.
